key.desktopscreens.host: Back to the game (from the desktop)
item.desktopscreens.tablet.tooltip: Right-click to use your PC's desktop
item.desktopscreens.tablet.tooltip_key: Or press %s while it's in your inventory
item.desktopscreens.screen_builder.toolt: Right-click a block, look where the screen should end, right-click again
Left-click cancels. Uses screens from your inventory
Shift-click a screen to move, resize or take it down
desktopscreens.builder.look_at_block: Look at a block to start a screen
desktopscreens.builder.too_big: Too big: at most %s × %s on this server
desktopscreens.screen.on: Screen on: it shows your desktop, only to you
desktopscreens.screen.in_use: This screen is in use by %s
desktopscreens.share.title: Share this screen
desktopscreens.share.sound.tooltip: Players near your shared screens hear your PC: everything but Minecraft and voice chat (Discord, Teams...), or only the program of the window your screens show. For all your sharing.
desktopscreens.share.scope.tooltip: This screen: its own list, which ends when you turn it off. All your screens: every screen you turn on, now and later. Someone on either list can watch.
desktopscreens.share.intro_screen: They see your desktop on this screen. They can only watch.
desktopscreens.share.intro_all: They see your desktop on all your screens. They can only watch.
desktopscreens.share.name: Player name
desktopscreens.share.not_yours: Only its owner can share this screen
desktopscreens.share.added_all: All your screens are shared with %s
desktopscreens.share.removed_all: Your screens are no longer all shared with %s
desktopscreens.hint.in_world_keys: %s Back to the game    %s Settings    %s Next monitor    %s One window
desktopscreens.hint.not_in_world: Not while using a screen in the world    %s Back to the game
desktopscreens.hint.controlling: Your mouse and keyboard now control %s.
desktopscreens.hint.keys: %s Back to the game    %s Settings    %s Next monitor    %s One window
desktopscreens.hint.in_place: Minecraft is on this monitor: your clicks go through it, and you see the real screen.
desktopscreens.hint.in_place_keys: %s Back to the game    %s Settings    %s Next monitor    %s One window
desktopscreens.hint.one_window: Just this window: %s    %s The whole monitor
desktopscreens.hint.no_window: Point the mouse at a window, then press %s.
desktopscreens.hint.window_closed: The window was closed: showing the whole monitor again.
desktopscreens.pip.needs_tablet: Picture-in-picture needs a Tablet in your inventory
desktopscreens.pip.nothing: Nothing pinned yet: %s in the desktop view pins the window under the mouse
desktopscreens.pip.title: Picture-in-picture
desktopscreens.pip.drag: Drag the picture to put it anywhere
desktopscreens.pip.gap.tooltip: How far it stays from the edges of the game window. 0: right in the corner
desktopscreens.pip.pinned_closed: a window that was closed (its monitor shows)
desktopscreens.pip.how: %s in the desktop view pins the window under the mouse, or over the empty desktop the whole monitor. Needs a Tablet in your inventory.
desktopscreens.pip.key_none: Show/hide key: none yet (Options, Controls, Desktop Screens)
desktopscreens.stream.title: Streaming (Discord, OBS)
desktopscreens.stream.why: Where a screen or PiP shows the monitor Minecraft is on, a note covers the game. To show the desktop behind it there, the game must hide from screen capture, and Windows then hides it from every program: streams show what's behind it.
desktopscreens.stream.never: Never (the default): streams always show Minecraft.
desktopscreens.stream.tip: Screens showing a window or another monitor never need this.
desktopscreens.stream.note.title: Hidden from Discord and OBS
desktopscreens.stream.note: Minecraft hides from screen sharing while something shows its monitor. To change it: Desktop Screens settings, Stream...
desktopscreens.cover.title: Minecraft is on this monitor
desktopscreens.cover.how: To see your desktop here: %s in the desktop, then Stream...
desktopscreens.cover.why: (Discord and OBS then can't see Minecraft)
desktopscreens.hint.scaling_in_place: Scaling: %s (not used here: this monitor is always shown 1:1)
desktopscreens.hint.view_in_place: View: %s (not used here: this monitor is always shown in place)
desktopscreens.hint.zoom_in_place: No zoom here: this monitor is always shown in place, 1:1.
desktopscreens.hint.protected: Protected video (DRM) is black in every screen capture.
desktopscreens.hint.protected_how: To watch it, move it to Minecraft's own monitor and switch there with %s.
desktopscreens.settings.title: Desktop Screens
desktopscreens.settings.source.tooltip: What the desktop view shows. To show just one window: while using the desktop, point the mouse at it and press %s + W. Press it again for the whole monitor.
desktopscreens.settings.view.tooltip: Framed keeps some of the world visible around the desktop; slide to choose how much. All the way left is fullscreen. %s + F switches while using the desktop. Minecraft's own monitor is always shown in place.
desktopscreens.settings.fast_capture.too: Uses DXGI Desktop Duplication: the picture updates as often as your monitor does (up to 144 Hz and more) and costs less. Off uses the old way (GDI, about 60 fps). Turn it off if the picture stays black or frozen.
desktopscreens.settings.use_desktop.need: Needs a Tablet in your inventory, or a screen
desktopscreens.settings.pip.tooltip: Picture-in-picture: a window or monitor, small in a corner while you play
desktopscreens.settings.stream.tooltip: Whether Discord, OBS and other screen sharing can see Minecraft
desktopscreens.settings.sharing.tooltip: Let other players see your desktop on this screen.
desktopscreens.error.windows_only: Desktop Screens only works on Windows for now.
desktopscreens.error.capture: Can't see the screen right now: %s
